<html:details id="cryptoDetails" class="crypto-details" hidden="hidden">
          <html:summary data-l10n-id="smime-crypto-details-summary"></html:summary>
          <vbox id="signatureCryptoDetails" collapsed="collapsed">
            <hbox>
              <label class="cert-label"
                     data-l10n-id="smime-crypto-signature-algorithm" />
              <description id="sigAlgorithm" />
            </hbox>
            <hbox>
              <label class="cert-label"
                     data-l10n-id="smime-crypto-digest-algorithm" />
              <description id="sigDigestAlgorithm" />
            </hbox>
          </vbox>
          <vbox id="encryptionCryptoDetails" collapsed="collapsed">
            <hbox>
              <label class="cert-label"
                     data-l10n-id="smime-crypto-cipher" />
              <description id="encAlgorithm" />
            </hbox>
            <hbox>
              <label class="cert-label"
                     data-l10n-id="smime-crypto-key-encryption" />
              <description id="keyEncAlgorithm" />
            </hbox>
          </vbox>
        </html:details>
